title: Yiqi Wenyang formula ameliorates mitochondrial damage in doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity by activating the SIRT1/PGC-1alpha signaling pathway.
authors: Liu, Zitian; Wang, Xiaoming; Zhou, Xiaonian; Li, Jixu; Luo, Qiuyan; Zhang, Shujie; Zhu, Yao; Jiang, Weimin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过SIRT1/PGC-1alpha通路改善线粒体损伤，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIM OF STUDY: Doxorubicin (Dox), as a common chemotherapeutic agent, induces cardiotoxicity by driving mitochondrial dysfunction and energy insufficiency. Yiqi Wenyang Formula (YQWYF) is an empirical prescription frequently used for treating heart failure (HF). This study aims to illustrate the therapeutic efficacy of YQWYF in treating Dox-induced cardiotoxicity, and the underlying mechanism. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Dox-induced cardiotoxicity was modeled in mice and H9c2 cells. Active compounds of YQWYF-loaded heart tissues and YQWYF dry powder were screened by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Morphological and functional changes in mitochondria of Dox-induced mice and H9c2 cells were examined via a series of examinations, including echocardiography, histological staining, transmission electron microscopy (TEM), Seahorse assay, JC-1 staining, and ATP content measurement. The regulatory effect of YQWYF on the SIRT1/PGC-1alpha signaling pathway was detected by Western blot, immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence staining. Molecular docking of active compounds of YQWYF to SIRT1 was finally performed. RESULTS: Dox induction significantly resulted in ventricular remodeling, ultrastructural changes in myocardial mitochondria, and ATP decline in mouse heart tissues. Similarly, Dox treatment significantly decreased the viability of H9c2 cells by 25%, which also impaired the mitochondrial ultrastructure, mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP) and ATP production in vitro. YQWYF significantly reversed Dox-induced mitochondrial dysfunction and ATP depletion in mouse heart tissues and H9c2 cells by activating the SIRT1/PGC-1alpha signaling pathway. A total of 28 active compounds of YQWYF were identified, showing strong binding affinities to SIRT1. CONCLUSION: YQWYF protects against Dox-induced cardiotoxicity by activating the SIRT1/PGC-1alpha signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 研究目的：多柔比星（Doxorubicin, Dox）作为一种常用化疗药物，通过驱动线粒体功能障碍和能量不足诱导心脏毒性。益气温阳方（Yiqi Wenyang Formula, YQWYF）是常用于治疗心力衰竭（heart failure, HF）的经验方。本研究旨在阐明YQWYF治疗Dox诱导心脏毒性的疗效及其潜在机制。材料与方法：在小鼠和H9c2细胞中建立Dox诱导的心脏毒性模型。通过液相色谱-串联质谱法（liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, LC-MS/MS）筛选YQWYF负载心脏组织和YQWYF干粉中的活性化合物。通过一系列检查，包括超声心动图、组织学染色、透射电子显微镜（transmission electron microscopy, TEM）、Seahorse测定、JC-1染色和ATP含量测量，检测Dox诱导小鼠和H9c2细胞中线粒体的形态和功能变化。通过Western blot、免疫组织化学和免疫荧光染色检测YQWYF对SIRT1/PGC-1alpha信号通路的调节作用。最后进行YQWYF活性化合物与SIRT1的分子对接。结果：Dox诱导显著导致小鼠心脏组织中的心室重构、心肌线粒体超微结构改变和ATP下降。类似地，Dox处理显著将H9c2细胞活力降低25%，并在体外损害线粒体超微结构、线粒体膜电位（mitochondrial membrane potential, MMP）和ATP产生。YQWYF通过激活SIRT1/PGC-1alpha信号通路，显著逆转了Dox诱导的小鼠心脏组织和H9c2细胞中的线粒体功能障碍和ATP耗竭。共鉴定出28种YQWYF活性化合物，显示出与SIRT1的强结合亲和力。结论：YQWYF通过激活SIRT1/PGC-1alpha信号通路，保护免受Dox诱导的心脏毒性。
